spec.title: Falsification-gated discovery: does an agent that chooses which crash mechanisms to test find more that hold up on sealed later years than code that tests everything?
spec.registered: validation/BENCH_PREREG.md, T15 (2026-11-01, before any detail table was fetched for it or any agent was run)
spec.explore: crashes before the split date; the agent's tools only ever read these
spec.sealed: crashes on or after the split date; read once by code after an arm has finished

corners.from: the city's screen, by injury crashes

null_corners.how: for each of the top 100 corners, the same number of crashes drawn at random from all screened corners' crashes, separately for each period; the arm sees a blind id

spec.pattern: 1 to 3 field=value conditions, all true for a crash (vehicle fields: any vehicle in the crash)
spec.test: one-sided binomial: the corner's share of crashes matching the pattern against the pooled share at all screened corners in the same period
spec.correction: Holm over every pattern an arm tested at a corner (the agent: every test_pattern call, not only those it reports); patterns passing explore are then tested once on sealed years with Holm over them

arms.agent: Muse Spark Open (Baseten) with describe, query_crashes and test_pattern tools on the explore years, blind corner ids, at most 12 tests per corner, then finish with the patterns it stands behind
arms.grid: every 1- and 2-condition pattern with at least min_matches explore matches (no model)
arms.greedy: the 10 patterns with the largest explore excess over the pooled share among 1- and 2-condition patterns (no model; what the agent's strategy could be without the model)

metrics: confirmed findings per real corner (passed explore and sealed)
null false discoveries per null corner
findings confirmed by one arm and not another
spec.rule: The agent arm is credited with finding what code misses only if, on real corners, its confirmed findings per corner exceed both the grid's and the greedy arm's (95% bootstrap interval of the difference above 0, resampling corners) and its null false discoveries per corner are at most 0.05. Everything is reported either way.
